sections.title: Transcription
sections.summary: Twenty-eight runnable packet envelopes with exact release assets, workload-derived prompt files, admission evidence, and public readback.
limitations: Packet PASS does not certify a completed transcription or edition.
Later candidate generations are excluded until their own independent admission checks pass.
Release totals include thirty runnable packet ZIPs and one retained historical translation-kit ZIP; runnable_asset_count and runnable_asset_bytes exclude that retained kit.

sections.title: Translation
sections.summary: A vendor-neutral starter, one self-contained Open Logic packet, 29 release-bound source scopes, nine exact public reader identities, and an additive education catalog with 40 Indonesian mathematics examples.

starter.workflow_note: The generic starter is runnable for listed and user-proposed works once the contributor supplies or obtains the exact source; its release is not a self-contained textbook packet.

limitations: The Open Logic release contains exact source and workflow material, not a completed translation.
The generic starter contains no textbook, source work, or completed translation.
The additive catalog/edu.json records current educational examples and evidence without changing the immutable v9 starter.
Most catalog rows do not have self-contained public packets; they remain workflow-startable through the generic starter and each row exposes its recorded distribution class and source note.

sections.title: Open problems
sections.summary: Workbench v0.2 was independently replayed. The unavailable ZIP contained candidate statements, review queues, literature queries, source-list imports, scripts, schemas, and templates. Its exact bytes must be restored before publication.
limitations: Publication is blocked until the exact expected ZIP bytes are restored and replayed.
No problem record is yet admitted as a canonical runnable packet.
Internal package PASS does not establish canonical wording, current status, complete literature, or a proof.
